body.content: Attack surface: The firewall's attack surface includes the route lease validation logic and the school-to-seat binding logic. For the lease-mismatch, the attack surface is the synchronous precondition check before any provider call. For the seat-binding, it is the endpoint identity comparison. Mutations that bypass these checks represent the primary false-green risk.
body.why_keep_this: This note maps the attack surface for both refusals, providing a foundation for the forbidden cases in the regression suite.
